nodes.label: Wall-Mounted Ventilation Fan
nodes.description: Photograph of a white square wall/window-mounted extractor fan (KDK-style) fitted into a dark panel, with a horizontally louvred front grille showing dust/soiling on the blades and a white supply cable running up out of frame.

nodes.label: Louvred Exhaust Grille
nodes.description: Horizontal-slat front grille that passes exhaust air while blocking large debris and birds; visible soiling on the louvres indicates the fouling/maintenance burden of an in-house fan.

nodes.label: Ventilation for Air-Quality and Humidity Control
nodes.rationale: An exhaust fan is the actuator that removes ammonia, CO2, dust and excess moisture from the poultry house. It is preferred to passive vents because it can be switched on demand from gas/humidity readings, but it also removes heat, so it must be arbitrated against the heat lamp rather than run independently.
